cards.explanation: The answer is False. The message says, "Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken." (Isaiah 14:29) It tells them not to rejoice. A broken rod sounds like a party with balloons, but the message has more to say. Keep that confetti in the closet, friends.

The answer is a viper. The message says, "…a viper will spring from the root of the snake, and a flying serpent from its egg." (Isaiah 14:29) So the snake's root isn't done producing trouble. A viper is a venomous snake, and the verse names a flying serpent too. That is a LOT of snake news for one verse, friends.

The answer is True. The message says, "Then the firstborn of the poor will find pasture, and the needy will lie down in safety…" (Isaiah 14:30) Pasture for the poor and safety for the needy. Lying down in safety sounds like the best nap of my life, friends, and I've napped in a drawer.

The answer is famine. The message says, "…I will kill your root by famine…" (Isaiah 14:30) This is a heavy line, friends. The root is what a plant grows from, and here it is the Philistines' root that is named.

The answer is False. The message says, "…I will kill your root by famine, and your remnant will be slain." (Isaiah 14:30) So the remnant is not spared. This is a heavy verse, friends, and it's good to read it slowly.

The answer is from the north. The message says, "…a cloud of smoke comes from the north…" (Isaiah 14:31) The gate and the city are told to wail because of it. Smoke on the horizon is a sight nobody wants to see, and I'd wail a little too, friends.

The answer is True. The message says, "…there are no stragglers in its ranks." (Isaiah 14:31) Nobody is lagging behind in that line. I could never keep my cookie cutters in a line that straight on the counter, so I'm impressed, friends.

The answer is refuge. The message says, "The LORD has founded Zion, where His afflicted people will find refuge." (Isaiah 14:32) Refuge is a safe place to run to. After the wailing in this passage, friends, it is good to end on that.
